name: Taliban (Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan)
native: د افغانستان اسلامي امارت (Də Afghānistān Islāmī Imārat)

predecessors.name: Afghanistan
predecessors.text: Kandahar City and the country round it, where 'a small Taliban militia first emerged near Kandahar in the spring and summer of 1994' and which it captured in October-November 1994

successors.name: Afghanistan
successors.text: all the land the Taliban still held when Kabul fell on 13 November 2001 and Kandahar on 7 December 2001, passing to the Northern Alliance / United Front and then the Afghan Interim Administration

ledger.x: 1994: Mullah Omar's Taliban emerge near Kandahar and take the city.
1996: by the proclamation of the Emirate the Taliban hold the south and west as well as Kandahar.
September 1996: Kabul becomes the capital of the Emirate (infobox 'Capital Kabul'); Mullah Omar remained at Kandahar, the movement's base.
27 September 1996: the Taliban movement becomes the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan.
September 1996: the Northern Alliance forms against the Taliban and the front moves north and east of Kabul.
8 August 1998: the Taliban attack Mazar-i-Sharif and break Dostum's northern base.
13 November 2001: Kabul falls to the Northern Alliance, five weeks after the US-led invasion began on 7 October 2001.
7 December 2001: Kandahar falls and the Taliban lose the last of their land.
December 2001: the Taliban-Alliance front ends with the fall of the Emirate; the Northern Alliance page says the Alliance 'controlled only about 5% of the country' by 2001 before the collapse.
7 December 2001: the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan falls.

wars.name: Taliban offensives against the Northern Alliance (Afghan civil war, 1996-2001)
wars.outcome: The Taliban took Kabul (27 September 1996), Mazar-i-Sharif (1998), Bamiyan (1999) and the Alliance headquarters Taloqan (5 September 2000) and held about 90% of the country; the Alliance, pushed to Badakhshan and the Panjshir, outlasted them and took Kabul on…

wars.name: Battles of Mazar-i-Sharif (1997-1998)
wars.outcome: The city 'was overrun in 1997' and Dostum's forces 'were defeated by the Taliban and their allies in 1998'; the Taliban page dates their attack to 8 August 1998.

wars.name: War in Afghanistan (2001-2021): the US-led invasion of 2001
wars.outcome: Invasion begins 7 October 2001; Kabul falls 13 November and Kandahar 7 December, ending the Islamic Emirate.
